core_meteorology_future_forcing.description: PM2.5 plus the same raw KnowAir meteorological information budget used by the release baseline; wind direction uses a circular sin/cos representation instead of one angular channel.
common_local_features: 100m_u/v_wind represented as speed and circular direction

extended_information.description: Adds future boundary-layer/source-sink covariates; comparisons against release AirDDE must be labelled as richer-input comparisons.

next_generation_test_policy: Train/validation only during development. The previously inspected KnowAir test is a diagnostic leaderboard, not a fresh lockbox.
